parry.plays: a hero parries an enemy hit at the right moment (press feedback)
parry.title: Parry

parry_final.plays: the last hit of an enemy string is parried: brighter, bigger than parry
parry_final.title: Final parry

dodge.plays: a hero dodges an enemy hit (press feedback)
dodge.title: Dodge

jump.plays: a hero jumps clear of a ground wave (press feedback)
jump.title: Jump

whiff.plays: a defence or skill press is early, late or the wrong button
whiff.title: Early or late press

locked.plays: a press during lockout, or a menu choice that is not allowed (muted click)
locked.title: Locked press

hurt.plays: a hero takes damage from an enemy hit
hurt.title: Hero gets hit

strike.plays: a hero's basic attack lands; also the exploring strike swing
strike.title: Basic attack

heavy_strike.plays: a big skill hit lands (Rend, Shield Bash...)
heavy_strike.title: Heavy skill hit

counter.plays: a counterattack after a perfect defence string; also FIRST STRIKE in a zone
counter.title: Counterattack

follow_up.plays: an ally's follow-up strike press lands
follow_up.title: Follow-up strike

skill_press.plays: a timed skill press is good or perfect (press feedback)
skill_press.title: Skill press

alert.plays: an enemy attack starts (once per attack); also an enemy touches you in a zone
alert.title: Enemy attack warning

lunge.plays: an enemy lunges or feints toward a hero, about 200 ms before impact
lunge.title: Enemy lunge

slam.plays: an enemy slams the ground and a ground wave launches
slam.title: Enemy ground slam

heal.plays: HP restored: heal skill, rest stop, shop potion
heal.title: Heal

buff.plays: a buff lands; also equipping gear, taking loot, buying gear
buff.title: Buff and gear

debuff.plays: a debuff lands on a target
debuff.title: Debuff and mark

gauge_full.plays: the team gauge fills; also a first strike opening
gauge_full.title: Team gauge full

turn_start.plays: a hero's turn starts (the action menu opens)
turn_start.title: Your turn

menu_move.plays: the cursor moves in any menu
menu_move.title: Menu cursor

metronome.plays: lag calibration beat: the player presses on each tick (must be razor sharp)
metronome.title: Calibration beat

parry_ring.title: Parry streak ring
parry_ring.plays: a bright ring on top of each perfect parry in a string; the game raises its pitch with every parry (card #93)

wrong_button.title: Wrong button
wrong_button.plays: you parried or dodged a hit that needed a jump, or jumped one that needed a parry (orange JUMP! or PARRY! hint)

guard_block.title: Guarded hit
guard_block.plays: an enemy hit lands on a Guarded hero and does less damage

skill_miss.title: Missed skill press
skill_miss.plays: a skill ring passes with no good press: MISS and a weak strike

exposed_burst.title: Exposed combo
exposed_burst.plays: a hit uses up an enemy's EXPOSED mark for bonus damage

ultimate_start.title: Ultimate begins
ultimate_start.plays: the Team Ultimate banner appears and all heroes step in

follow_up_ready.title: Follow-up ready
follow_up_ready.plays: an ally steps forward as their blue FOLLOW-UP ring appears (a heads-up for that player)

windup.title: Enemy wind-up
windup.plays: builds up just before an enemy hit lands; its loudest point is its very end, which the game lines up with the impact (card #94)

enemy_crumble.title: Enemy crumbles
enemy_crumble.plays: a beaten enemy dissolves pixel by pixel with a glowing green edge

boss_rage.title: Boss rages
boss_rage.plays: the Hollow King enters phase two: red flash and a RAGES banner

status_applied.title: Status sticks
status_applied.plays: a status lands on a fighter: SLOWED, EXPOSED, TAUNTED, GUARDED or RIPOSTE

status_expired.title: Status wears off
status_expired.plays: a status ends and its badge disappears

timeline_shift.title: Turn order shifts
timeline_shift.plays: a fighter's next turn moves (DELAYED or HASTE) and the timeline reshuffles

low_hp_warning.title: Low HP warning
low_hp_warning.plays: a hero drops into danger HP and the red edge pulse starts (plays once, not a loop)

fight_start.title: Fight begins
fight_start.plays: a normal fight starts and the fighters appear

escape_fail.title: Run away fails
escape_fail.plays: a Run press is not perfect: the hero stays and the turn is lost

gold_gain.title: Gold earned
gold_gain.plays: the fight end screen shows the gold you won

level_up.title: Level up
level_up.plays: the fight end screen shows LEVEL UP

pause_open.title: Pause opens
pause_open.plays: the pause menu opens over a zone, a fight or the map

footstep_grass.title: Footstep on grass
footstep_grass.plays: the leader takes a step on grass and earth (Rotten Hollow)

footstep_mud.title: Footstep in mud
footstep_mud.plays: the leader takes a step in mud and muck (Sunken Bog)

footstep_stone.title: Footstep on stone
footstep_stone.plays: the leader takes a step on stone and ash (Ashen Ruins)

enemy_notice.title: Enemy spots you
enemy_notice.plays: a roaming enemy sees the leader and a red ! appears before it chases

enemy_give_up.title: Enemy gives up
enemy_give_up.plays: a chasing enemy loses you and turns back home

encounter_swirl.title: Fight transition
encounter_swirl.plays: the screen freezes and swirls into black as a fight starts

zone_enter.title: Zone arrival
zone_enter.plays: the zone's name fades in as you arrive

zone_clear.title: Zone cleared
zone_clear.plays: the guard is beaten and ZONE CLEAR shows

run_begin.title: Run starts
run_begin.plays: a new run starts and the map appears for the first time

loot_reveal.title: Loot reveal
loot_reveal.plays: the spoils screen appears after beating a guard

run_cleared.title: Run cleared
run_cleared.plays: RUN CLEARED after beating the Hollow King

run_over.title: Run over
run_over.plays: RUN OVER after the party falls

player_join.title: Player joins
player_join.plays: a friend connects and appears in the players list

player_leave.title: Player leaves
player_leave.plays: a friend disconnects, before or during a run

net_connected.title: Connected
net_connected.plays: joining worked and the online players screen appears

net_error.title: Connection problem
net_error.plays: joining failed, or the online game ended for you

voice_husk.title: Rotten Husk voice
voice_husk.plays: the Rotten Husk starts an attack (a groan); quieter and higher when it is hit

voice_bloat.title: Bloat voice
voice_bloat.plays: the Bloat starts an attack (a wet gurgle); quieter and higher when it is hit

voice_gnats.title: Gnat Swarm voice
voice_gnats.plays: the Gnat Swarm starts an attack (a buzz); quieter and higher when it is hit

voice_shade.title: Shade voice
voice_shade.plays: the Shade starts an attack (a whisper); quieter and higher when it is hit

voice_king.title: Hollow King voice
voice_king.plays: the Hollow King starts an attack (a roar); quieter and higher when he is hit

shout_alder.title: Alder's shout
shout_alder.plays: Alder uses a skill or joins the Team Ultimate (card #102)

shout_brin.title: Brin's shout
shout_brin.plays: Brin uses a skill or joins the Team Ultimate (card #102)

shout_cass.title: Cass's shout
shout_cass.plays: Cass uses a skill or joins the Team Ultimate (card #102)

item_lift.title: Backpack: pick up
item_lift.plays: an item is picked up in the backpack to move it

item_place.title: Backpack: put down
item_place.plays: an item is put down in the backpack

item_turn.title: Backpack: turn
item_turn.plays: the item in hand is turned a quarter turn

item_no_room.title: Backpack: no room
item_no_room.plays: the item in hand does not fit where you tried to put it

item_drop.title: Backpack: throw away
item_drop.plays: an item is thrown away (or a find left behind)

item_found.title: Found an item
item_found.plays: the leader picks up a glinting spot in a zone

chest_open.title: Chest opens
chest_open.plays: a key opens a locked chest in a zone

voice_hyena.title: Rot Hyena voice
voice_hyena.plays: the Rot Hyena starts an attack; quieter and higher when it is hit

voice_toad.title: Mire Toad voice
voice_toad.plays: the Mire Toad starts an attack; quieter and higher when it is hit

voice_fly.title: Carrion Fly voice
voice_fly.plays: the Carrion Fly starts an attack; quieter and higher when it is hit

spit.title: Spit
spit.plays: a monster spits a glob at a hero (bile, maggots, mud)

splat.title: Glob splat
splat.plays: a spat glob hits a hero

throw.title: Throw
throw.plays: a monster throws a stone or a cinder at a hero

bolt_cast.title: Shadow bolt
bolt_cast.plays: a shade lets a shadow bolt fly

rock_rumble.title: Rock wave
rock_rumble.plays: rocks start bursting out of the ground toward the party

critical.title: Critical hit
critical.plays: a hero's hit is a critical hit (CRITICAL! over the number)

voice_rat.title: Rat voice
voice_rat.plays: a Rot Rat or Grave Rat starts an attack (they barked like a dog before); quieter and higher when it is hit

thunder.title: Thunder
thunder.plays: a storm in a zone: lightning lights the sky, then thunder rolls in the distance

streak_swell.title: Defence streak
streak_swell.plays: your party lands 5 perfect parries or jumps in a row (and every 5 after); the music swells with it
